checks.claim: 184 / 3,321 / 12,331 rows; summary.json flag counts; labels correct
checks.recomputed: Rows 184 / 3,321 / 12,331; SHA256SUMS 4/4 match. Flag counts recomputed from the 'flags' column equal summary.json exactly for singles, pairs, triples (n_no_flags 38 / 10 / 2; 'none' is the empty-flag token); n_flags equals the number of flags on every row; 'impossible coupling' == eta_at_q99E > 1 on every row (5 pairs, 5 triples); 'before 00:19:29' recomputed 371 pairs, 2 triples. 10 rows re-derived (3 singles, 3 pairs, 2 triples random seed 11, plus 1 positioned single and 1 triple with a locus): band, receiver, shot (+dt), land (+inner land points: 18, 164, 0...), impact-time and coupling labels all agree.

Random draw was heavy on 3250 and no-position rows, so 2 fully assessed rows were added.
Differences <= 0.3 %, from 0.25 deg grid interpolation versus my direct +/-1 deg window.

checks.claim: same keys; IMS rows identical on all common columns; SNR offset 10*log10(2.26e-3/2.1e-4) on every finite row; v3 reads imos_tl_ram_arc.csv

checks.claim: No detection/absence, certainty or 'published work is wrong' statements in the new files
checks.recomputed: Hits that are certainty claims: (a) INDEX.md:128 (D04): '2-5 Hz members at IMOS (hardware corner 8 Hz) and on Kadri panels (5 Hz high-pass) cannot be impact sound in that band.' (b) ERRATA_v2_text.txt:7-8 (item 4): 'the H08S 01:12:49 raw-panel row lies 0.14 s from an airgun shot ... It is not an independent arrival.' (c) ERRATA_v2_text.txt:5-6 (item 3): '... is time-consistent with Royer 2016 icequake A (it lies inside Royer's Fig. 4 H01W pick bar ...)' stated without the H01W-2 timing caveat. No statement that a detection exists; no statement that another researcher's work is wrong (D13 at INDEX.md:136 and ERRATA item 6 explicitly say the opposite). decisions.md P17 contains 'definitively isn't a detectable signal' but it is Pete's quoted request.
checks.evidence: (a) A corner/high-pass attenuates below the corner, it does not remove all energy; 'cannot' is a certainty claim. (b) conflicts with Pete P23/P24 (shot present can still contain a detection) and with the register README line 11 ('NOT an exclusion'); 0.136 s recomputed. (c) see item 5 caveat.

other_findings: Register flag text is wrong for 2,779 pairs and 195 triples: 'not assessed: coupling not computable (fewer than 20 run J impacts within 1 deg)' is applied when eta_level_locus is inf (2,577 pairs, all with 3250) or NaN (202 pairs, 195 triples); all these rows have E_q50/E_q99 at the locus. Cause: build_register.py lines 78 and 105 map every NOT_COMPUTABLE (gates.py line 175, any non-finite input) to the 'fewer than 20' text.

D01 coverage gap: note.injection_recovery_run_j (line 13: 'about three times the F-35A anchor (2.1 x 10^-4)') has defects D05, D06, D22 only; ex.run_j_gated_v2 README line 11 ('eta = 2.1e-4 (F-35A upper anchor, Brown et al. 2026)') has D05, D06, D20, D25 only. Both are CURRENT_WITH_CAVEATS without D01, although the stale-wording TSV lists these lines.

Single-factor spread '2.8e-4 to 5.4e-2' (registry eta_F35A_metz note, D01 text, INDEX, brief line 143, Metz note line 171) omits the f^-4 roll-off case in the same note's table (line 70: 1.3e-1). The prior upper bound 1e-2 (eta_prior_bounds) lies below the 2 m-source (5.4e-2) and f^-4 (1.3e-1) values, so the agent-chosen prior truncates part of the F-35A single-factor range; this is not stated in the brief or INDEX.

Royer H01W-2 timing: in royer_figure_marks.csv every H01W-2 pick bar is +7.7 to +16.6 s after Royer's Table 5 arrival for that event (13.8 s for event A), and H01W-2 arrows mostly +6 to +18 s, while MAD, SSEIR, SWAMS, WKER, NCRO bars are within about +/-5 s (outliers are second bars). Against Table 5 (00:51:42.99) Kadri's 00:52:03 is +20 s, outside the +/-2 s pick-bar rule. D07, ERRATA item 3 and the register's 4 single + 199 pair + 2,690 triple 'H01W time-consistent with Royer' flags depend on the digitised bar position; this sensitivity is not stated. Similarly D07's 'caption time 00:54:30 is 6 s from Royer event 5' is 5.9 s from the digitised arrow (00:54:24.06) but 17.6 s from Table 5 (00:54:12.44).

Kadri v3: README.txt and v2_v3_comparison.json state IMS rows identical on all common columns, but 'labels' differs on all 645 IMS rows; README says SNR difference 10.3 dB 'on every row' but 240 of 1,275 finite rows show 10.4 dB (rounding; exposure ratio exactly 10.762). build_predictions_v3.py keeps the v2 docstring text 'F-35A upper anchor 2.1e-4' (lines 8-9) and 'IMOS: RAM-corrected table' (line 29), which contradict its own change list.

ERRATA_v2_text.txt item 4 says the H08S 01:12:49 row 'is not an independent arrival'. This is a certainty claim and conflicts with Pete's rulings P23/P24 and the register README ('NOT an exclusion'). INDEX D04 says 2-5 Hz members 'cannot be impact sound in that band'; a hardware corner or Butterworth high-pass attenuates, it does not eliminate.

Provenance: REGISTRY.json 'git' and the INDEX header record module 590c80f and work fe5cdfd (HEADs before the clean-up commits), not c9ac5cc / 81e5526 that contain the registry and the banners; content hashes nevertheless match the committed files. The code.module_prepare manifest includes 18 untracked __pycache__/.pytest_cache files that are not in the repo. 7 of 34 registry quotes have leading whitespace stripped, so 'quote equals file lines' holds only after strip().

Brief rule 1 (only WITHDRAWN and KNOWN_DEFECT excluded) is weaker than INDEX line 5 (use only CURRENT or CURRENT_WITH_CAVEATS); brief rule 3 adds 'where it runs and the development time', which is wider than Pete's quoted P39/P40 (computational time). decisions.md's '46 hydroacoustic frames' could not be checked (the Pete-messages artifact has 11 frames; 8 are cited).
structured_output.summary: The core numbers reproduce from raw files: registry hashes (40/40 random, plus all WORK/ART files), the review gate counts (35, 1,111, 63, 2,584, 11,067, 44 of 47), the land path (201 of 2,000; 0 for the four 37.1S paths), the Royer checks, the register flag counts and 10 re-derived rows, the energy grid and coupling multiples (<=0.3 %), the 52 quotes, the 13 banners, INDEX vs registry, and the live profile. The module tests pass (9/9). Errors found: (1) a wrong reason text on 2,779 pair and 195 triple flags ('fewer than 20 impacts' where the cause is inf/NaN coupling); (2) D01 missing on two items that still call 2.1e-4 the F-35A anchor; (3) the stated F-35A single-factor spread upper end 5.4e-2 is contradicted by the note's own f^-4 value 1.3e-1, which is also above the 1e-2 prior bound; (4) Kadri v3 README/json overstate identity (labels differ on IMS rows; 10.4 dB on 240 rows) and the v3 script docstring keeps the old anchor wording; (5) two certainty statements (INDEX D04 'cannot', ERRATA item 4 'not an independent arrival'); (6) the Royer H01W match depends on digitised H01W-2 marks that are +8 to +17 s from Royer's Table 5, which is not stated. Quotes match only after leading-whitespace strip for 7 of 34.

Item 10: the '46 frames' source count is NOT CHECKED; the Pete-messages artifact holds 11 frames.
